critical_code_review_comments: PRICING SPEC v2.0 implementation is clean and passes all review scenarios end-to-end: single source of truth at /api/settings/rates, correct 403 for sales, correct cushion-folding for sales /api/scopes/pricing-values (x1.10 dollar values, cushion set to 0), and correct scope-save 403 when sales requests mode=final.

Out-of-state (dropoff=NY) shows scope-out-of-state-block banner, replaces price with scope-state-refusal-card, and disables scope-save-btn — full gating works.
The old Quote Calculator route (/calculator) is properly removed — catch-all routes owner to Dashboard and sales to /leads, no Quote Calculator sidebar entries remain.
/haul-yeah-phone-script.docx static asset is deployed and returns HTTP 200 with correct MIME (40949 bytes).

context_for_next_testing_agent: PRICING SPEC v2.0 is fully verified. Backend endpoint shapes: (a) GET /api/settings/rates returns FLAT dict of all rates (44 keys visible incl. _updatedAt metadata) — response is NOT wrapped in {values:...}. (b) GET /api/scopes/pricing-values returns FLAT dict too; folds cushion into every CUSHION_FOLDED_KEYS entry x(1+cushion/100) and sets cushionPercent=0 when tier=='sales'. (c) POST /api/scopes ScopeSavePayload requires: lead_id?, label?, inputs, pricing, result, survey_complete?, refined_from?, video?. Sales-tier 403 when result.mode=='final' or inputs.mode=='final'. (d) Ghost admins (TestSalesAdmin etc.) log in as OWNER by design; to test sales-tier behavior via curl/pytest you MUST call POST /api/auth/switch-role {role:'sales'} and use the returned token. The frontend sidebar 'Sales account' button at the bottom does this same call. (e) Scope calc canonical 2BR band with defaults = $1,250–$1,400 (was $1,150–$1,250 in v1). (f) Distance zones: 0-20 free, 21-40 +$150, 41-60 +$300, >60 blocked (scope-custom-quote-block). (g) NJ is the only serviceState; NY dropoff triggers refusal card. (h) 3BR+ hard 6-hour floor only visibly triggers scope-hard-floor-note when volume/items push billMH BELOW 6h*crew — using the 3BR package button (pkg3brHours=6.5) sets hours above the floor so the note stays hidden; this is correct per engine logic (hardFloorApplied requires floor to be the binding constraint).
